note: 3.8. Book, cancel and reschedule in ONE call, all three correct, every claim backed, verdict ok. It refused to guess between two appointments: looked them up, asked which, read the chosen one back before writing.

Thanks. What is the name of your company?
Thanks. And what industry is your company in?
Perfect. What services or products do you sell?

You have one remaining appointment scheduled for Monday, September twenty-first at one p-m.

turns.caller: Ahm, okay, let's reschedule that to 2:00 p.m. same day.
turns.assistant: Shall I go ahead and reschedule your appointment to Monday, September twenty-first at two p-m?
That appointment is now rescheduled to Monday, September twenty-first at two p-m. Is there anything else you need?
Perfect. Thank you for calling Digile Media, and have a great day.
